rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB grading and plausible blastocyst features, but it adds image-specific details such as exact quadrant location of the ICM, debris, and early hatching/herniation that may not be reliably supported from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, sperm factors, first-cycle status, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and uterine factors to prognosis; however, some probability adjustments and mechanistic claims are somewhat speculative.

Core points such as good prognosis from age, concern about thin endometrium, and SET are aligned, but several recommendations (routine ERA, EMMA/ALICE, thrombophilia screening, PRP/G-CSF/sildenafil, broad freeze-all stance) go beyond or are not strongly supported by major guidelines.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer versus freeze-all, future FET planning, endometrial optimization, and additional workup with practical alternatives.
